important_caveat: For 9dc833ab the next full Windows run is the only valid budget measurement; this report makes no total-time or 900-second completion promise.

recommendations.estimated_saving: unmeasured; at most one initial networkidle navigation; likely subsecond, not a budget fix
recommendations.evidence: The page is first navigated to base to instantiate the renderer for the subsequent CDP sandbox audit, then login() navigates that same page to the same base again.
recommendations.proposal: Keep the first navigation and sandbox audit; allow the following login call to reuse the loaded page and continue with token/login assertions.
recommendations.verification_after_change: measure the browser step and confirm authentication, sandbox audits, check records, screenshot outputs, and receipt still complete.

recommendations.coverage_change: none intended; exact line protocol and per-file bytes/SHA declarations must remain unchanged
recommendations.estimated_saving: unknown; the 6.901s span is not isolated write time and this cannot be presented as a guaranteed saving
recommendations.evidence: Historical run emitted 9 files in 712 chunks over a 6.901s timestamp span; each line currently flushes.
recommendations.proposal: Consider writing the unchanged header and chunk lines as one buffered write per completed file, followed by one flush.
recommendations.verification_after_change: run the approved evidence path, decode output, and compare filenames, byte counts, SHA-256, receipt metadata, check counts, and sandbox audit JSON.

recommendations.evidence: The 9dc tree replaces one Python fixture subprocess per action with one owned child session that handles bounded actions. `conditional-checks-ui.cjs:34` waits 2.7s for an actual 2.5s poll assertion.
recommendations.proposal: Retain the session reuse and real-poll wait; avoid classifying either as redundant startup or removable sleep.

recommendations.evidence: The historical `pytest -q` output and Report step provide aggregate JUnit counts, not per-test durations; 9dc also adds/changes seven test files.
recommendations.proposal: On a separately authorized run, add pytest duration reporting (for example `--durations=20`) while keeping the complete suite and assertions.
